subject: maths
question: In an election between two candidates, 95% of the registered voters cast their vote and 20% of the votes polled were found invalid. The winning candidate got 59% of the valid votes and won the election by a margin of 1881 votes. How many voters were registered?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Winning margin = 59% − 41% = 18% of the valid votes.

Valid votes = 80% of polled votes, and polled votes = 95% of total registered voters.

Let the total number of registered voters be T.

T × 95% × 80% × 18% = 1881

T × (19/20) × (4/5) × (9/50) = 1881 ⇒ T = 13750

**∴ The correct answer is 13750 voters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Registered voters who cast their vote = 95%

Invalid votes = 20%

Winning candidate's share = 59% of valid votes

Winning margin = 1881 votes

 
 Total Voters (100x)
 
 
• 
 95% vote

 80% valid
 
 
 Valid Votes (76x)

 Winner
 59% (44.84x)
 
 
 Loser
 41% (31.16x)
 
 Margin = 18% of 76x = 13.68x = 1881

⇒ Let the total number of registered voters be 100x

⇒ Votes polled = 95% of 100x = 95x

⇒ Valid votes = (100% − 20%) of 95x = 80% of 95x = 76x

⇒ Winner's votes = 59% of 76x = 44.84x

⇒ Loser's votes = (100% − 59%) of 76x = 41% of 76x = 31.16x

⇒ Winning margin = Winner's votes − Loser's votes

⇒ Winning margin = 44.84x − 31.16x = 13.68x

⇒ 13.68x = 1881

⇒ x = 1881 ÷ 13.68 = 137.5

⇒ Total registered voters = 100x = 100 × 137.5 = 13750

**∴ The correct answer is 13750 voters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Election Percentage Concept

In election problems, always track the remaining pool of valid votes progressively. Flow: Total Voters → Polled Votes → Valid Votes → Distributed Votes.

Successive Percentage Formula

When a base value undergoes continuous percentage changes, Final Value = Initial Value × (1 ± R₁/100) × (1 ± R₂/100).

Margin of Victory

The winning margin is always calculated as the absolute difference between the winner's percentage share and the nearest rival's percentage share of the valid votes.
